title: NFTown
tagline: NFTown is an NFT (meta-)marketplace with a Super NES JRPG-style UI
description: Welcome to NFTown! Feel free to walk around this little JRPG village with the OpenSea house up north, the Zora mansion down south and some hidden NFTs for the most adventurous of you. Originally the project was to make a town where players can interact with major NFT Marketplaces like OpenSea or Zora-compliant auction houses but it's all a work in progress
how_its_made: It's made with RPG Maker, I've made a custom plugin to interact with Web3 and send requests to NFTPort API. I wasted a lot of time trying to look for boilerplates using Phaser and in the end, the final product I'll be presenting has been completely remade from scratch during the last 7 hours of the hackathon
